# Taken 2026-10-30 on container 1.6.1 (macOS 27.0.1), by asking the runtime directly and then
# through opossum built from this change. One local image, built here and removed afterwards:
# opossum-probe-amd:1, from `FROM alpine:3.20` with `CMD ["uname","-m"]`, built with
# `container build --platform linux/amd64`, so it lists linux/amd64 alone.
#
# Asked for arm64, 1.6.1 says what was asked for and what the image has; on 1.4.1 the same run
# said `Error: platform linux/arm64` (platform-unsupported-fresh-pull-141.txt). `--arch arm64`
# alone is written `*/arm64`. With `platform: linux/amd64`, as the advice says, the service
# runs the amd64 build and exits at once (its CMD is `uname -m`), which is OPSM-407, not a
# failure of the platform: its log says x86_64. No container is left after a refusal.

$ container --version
container CLI version 1.6.1 (build: release, commit: unspeci)

# shape 2: local image built for linux/amd64 alone, run as linux/arm64
$ container run --rm --name opossum-probe-run --platform linux/arm64 opossum-probe-amd:1
--- exit code: 1
--- stdout ---
--- stderr ---
[0/6] [0s]
[0/6] [0s]
Error: image opossum-probe-amd:1 does not support linux/arm64; available: [ContainerizationOCI.Platform(osVersion: nil, osFeatures: nil, variant: nil, _rawOS: "linux", _rawArch: "amd64")]

$ container run --rm --name opossum-probe-run --arch arm64 opossum-probe-amd:1
--- exit code: 1
--- stdout ---
--- stderr ---
[0/6] [0s]
[0/6] [0s]
Error: image opossum-probe-amd:1 does not support */arm64; available: [ContainerizationOCI.Platform(osVersion: nil, osFeatures: nil, variant: nil, _rawOS: "linux", _rawArch: "amd64")]

# opossum up, platform: linux/arm64, image local and amd64 only
$ opossum up
--- exit code: 1
--- stdout ---
Creating network p29probe-net
Starting amd (opossum-probe-amd:1)
Nothing this `up` started is left running
--- stderr ---
[0/6] [0s]
[0/6] [0s]
Error: image opossum-probe-amd:1 does not support linux/arm64; available: [ContainerizationOCI.Platform(osVersion: nil, osFeatures: nil, variant: nil, _rawOS: "linux", _rawArch: "amd64")]
opossum: starting service "amd": exit status 1
  → [OPSM-412] this image has no build for Apple silicon (arm64). Set `platform: linux/amd64` on the service — opossum runs an amd64 image through Rosetta.
